description: Compare two versions of structured tabular or record data — CSV exports, JSON API responses, or similar — and produce a categorized, human-readable report of what actually changed, not a raw text/line diff. Matches rows by an identifying column (id, sku, uuid, or a composite key), not by row position, so a reordered or inserted row doesn't cascade into false changes. Treats type differences (42 vs "42") and floating-point rounding noise (19.999999999 vs 20.0) as non-changes by default. Use when the user has two CSVs, two JSON files, an "old" and "new" export, a "before" and "after" snapshot, or two API responses and asks what changed, what's different, what was added/removed/modified, or wants a diff — especially when they mention row order changing, columns being reordered, or that a plain text/unified diff isn't useful because of reordering or noise.
